001package org.clafer.ast.analysis;
002
003import java.util.HashMap;
004import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
005import java.util.Map;
006import java.util.Set;
007import org.clafer.ast.AstAbstractClafer;
008import org.clafer.ast.AstClafer;
009import org.clafer.ast.AstConcreteClafer;
010import org.clafer.ast.Card;
011import org.clafer.scope.Scope;
012
013/**
014 *
015 * @author jimmy
016 */
017public class ScopeAnalyzer implements Analyzer {
018
019    /*
020     * Shrinks the scope if it's greater than the upper global cardinality.
021     * Also set abstract scopes.
022     */
023    @Override
024    public Analysis analyze(Analysis analysis) {
025        Scope scope = analysis.getScope();
026        Map<AstClafer, Integer> optimizedScope = new HashMap<>();
027        optimizedScope.put(analysis.getModel().getRoot(), 1);
028
029        for (Set<AstClafer> component : analysis.getClafersInParentAndSubOrder()) {
030            // In a recursive structure, e.g. abstract Element with clip : Clip ?, abstract
031            // Group : Element and abstract Clip : Group, the clafers of a component depend on
032            // each other: the scope of an abstract clafer is the sum of the scopes of its sub
033            // clafers, and the scope of a concrete clafer with an exact cardinality is a
034            // multiple of its parent's. Each clafer is analyzed once the clafers it depends on
035            // are; only a concrete clafer on a cycle is analyzed without its parent's scope.
036            // An abstract clafer analyzed before one of its sub clafers would get a smaller
037            // scope than its sub clafers together.
038            Set<AstClafer> remaining = new LinkedHashSet<>(component);
039            while (!remaining.isEmpty()) {
040                AstClafer next = null;
041                for (AstClafer clafer : remaining) {
042                    if (dependenciesAnalyzed(analysis, clafer, optimizedScope, component)) {
043                        next = clafer;
044                        break;
045                    }
046                }
047                if (next == null) {
048                    // A cycle: a concrete clafer whose abstract parent is not analyzed yet.
049                    for (AstClafer clafer : remaining) {
050                        if (clafer instanceof AstConcreteClafer) {
051                            next = clafer;
052                            break;
053                        }
054                    }
055                }
056                if (next instanceof AstConcreteClafer) {
057                    AstConcreteClafer concreteClafer = (AstConcreteClafer) next;
058                    Card card = analysis.getCard(concreteClafer);
059                    Integer parentScope = concreteClafer.hasParent()
060                            ? optimizedScope.get(concreteClafer.getParent()) : null;
061                    if (card.isExact() && parentScope != null) {
062                        optimizedScope.put(next, parentScope * card.getLow());
063                    } else {
064                        Card globalCard = analysis.getGlobalCard(next);
065                        optimizedScope.put(next, Math.min(scope.getScope(next), globalCard.getHigh()));
066                    }
067                } else {
068                    int subScopes = 0;
069                    for (AstClafer sub : ((AstAbstractClafer) next).getSubs()) {
070                        subScopes += optimizedScope.containsKey(sub) ? optimizedScope.get(sub) : scope.getDefaultScope();
071                    }
072                    optimizedScope.put(next, subScopes);
073                }
074                remaining.remove(next);
075            }
076        }
077        return analysis.setScope(scope.withScopes(optimizedScope));
078    }
079
080    private static boolean dependenciesAnalyzed(Analysis analysis, AstClafer clafer,
081            Map<AstClafer, Integer> optimizedScope, Set<AstClafer> component) {
082        if (clafer instanceof AstConcreteClafer) {
083            AstConcreteClafer concreteClafer = (AstConcreteClafer) clafer;
084            return !concreteClafer.hasParent()
085                    || !analysis.getCard(concreteClafer).isExact()
086                    || !component.contains(concreteClafer.getParent())
087                    || optimizedScope.containsKey(concreteClafer.getParent());
088        }
089        for (AstClafer sub : ((AstAbstractClafer) clafer).getSubs()) {
090            if (component.contains(sub) && !optimizedScope.containsKey(sub)) {
091                return false;
092            }
093        }
094        return true;
095    }
096}
